items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And there’s a friend of mine, Warren Vache, who said it’s not the traveling

ctx.x: Right. If you were to tell them that boy it sure was hard getting here today, what’s the difference to them?

Yeah. And there’s a friend of mine, Warren Vache, who said it’s not the traveling — we don’t get paid for the music, we get paid for the traveling. And that’s really what it’s all about because the music makes it worth while, as cliché as that sounds, there’s no other reason why we would do something like this.

When you’re in Spain, you get with this local band, and you have a repertoire of tunes that you know, and that you hope that they know, do you get a little talk-through rehearsal with them beforehand? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
